title: ‘It’s Not Going to Be Just Sole Leadership’: Quinn Simmons Campaigns for Tour of Flanders
content:
After helping Mads Pedersen at the Tour and riding into late-season form, the 25-year-old says Lidl-Trek needs two cards on the table to beat Tadej Pogačar, Mathieu van der Poel, and Wout van Aert.

Read the full article at ‘It’s Not Going to Be Just Sole Leadership’: Quinn Simmons Campaigns for Tour of Flanders on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
